observations: Photo 0 shows a shrink-wrapped machine with a visible brand plate reading 'SHARP' and model 'AR-M207'.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from another angle, again reading 'SHARP AR-M207', with a 'digital' logo sticker and paper-size indicators (A4, A3).
Photo 2 is a close duplicate angle of photo 0, also showing 'SHARP AR-M207' through the plastic wrap.
No photo shows the machine powered on, a control panel lit up, a page count/meter reading, or internal toner/drum components.
The plastic wrap obscures parts of the housing, so any dents, cracks or missing panels underneath cannot be assessed.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, serial tag, or usage log visible in any photo to confirm origin or usage history.
Photos 0, 1 and 2 clearly show the printed model plate as 'AR-M207', not M307.

claims.claim: Packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text; no screen, print sample, or function panel shown to confirm working features.

risks.proof: A video or photo of the unit powered on with a clean test print/copy output

risks.risk: Toner, drum, or fuser may be worn or near end-of-life
risks.proof: Photo of internal toner/drum unit and a recent service/maintenance sticker

risks.risk: High page count / heavy prior usage not disclosed
risks.proof: Photo of the page counter/meter display

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or structural damage under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Clear unwrapped photos from all sides
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible cosmetic damage

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on producing a test copy or print
Unwrapped photos from multiple angles showing full housing condition
response.reason: The unit is clearly identifiable as a Sharp AR-M207 basic monochrome copier from the visible model plate, but no proof of power-on function, usage history, or internal condition exists, so it must be priced at worst case; only the Sharp AR-M160 listing in the comparables is of the same basic analog Sharp copier class, making it the sole valid match for both ends of the range.
